label: PF Backlog 178
title: Multi-modal capability (backend): modality + media loaders/generators + model routing + asset ids
body: Add multi-modal I/O to agents. (1) `modality` field on knowledge/skills (text|image|audio|video|3d|sensor) + knowledge_router branch. (2) Media LOADERS: STT (audio->text), vision/OCR (image->text or native vision message), video frame-sampler + captions + audio transcript, CAD/3D/sensor geometry->structured. (3) Media GENERATORS (output render step): text->image (diffusion), text->video, text->speech (TTS), text->3D/CAD - reusing the artifact + derived-formats idea. (4) Multi-modal models in the registry/tiers (vision/audio/video) + routing. (5) Media ASSETS get ids + traceability (like artifacts); bounded digests + the existing context-overflow map-reduce apply per modality.
_note: core/modality.py (detect/models_for_input/models_for_output/generators_needed/capabilities_for_project); wired pipeline_executor._run_model_fit_preflight -> logs [Modality] + generators needed. Verified voice+video+3d detection and image-input model resolution.
